text: 金十数据9月8日讯，9月8日，中国贸促会副会长林红红在京会见美国惠普公司首席法务官兼总法律顾问朱莉·雅各布斯一行。双方围绕服务外资企业在华发展、深化产业链供应链国际合作、参与2026年APEC系列工商界活动等议题进行交流。
text_en: On September 8, Jin Shi Data reported that Lin Honghong, Vice President of the China Council for the Promotion of International Trade, met in Beijing with Julie Jacobs, Chief Legal Officer and General Counsel of HP Inc. and her delegation. The two sides exchanged views on topics including serving foreign enterprises' development in China, deepening international cooperation on industry and supply chains, and participating in APEC business events in 2026.
